author: CBR
description:
Owen Harris explains why A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms stays so closely tied to Dunk’s point of view, making this Game of Thrones prequel feel more grounded, painful, and personal. In this Heroes Journey clip, Harris breaks down how the show looks at Westeros from the small folk perspective instead of through kings, lords, and nobles.
